parameters.name: AssociationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the association between the ECR and the VPC or transit router.

> Specify either the **InstanceId** or **AssociationId** parameter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique client-side value to ensure that the request is idempotent. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** is unique for each request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: The system runs a check request. It does not modify any resources.

- **false** (default): The system sends a normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the network instance that is associated with the ECR.

> Specify either the **InstanceId** or **AssociationId** parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: A virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

- **TR**: A transit router (TR) instance.
